findings.highlight: Without waiting for a response, she turns and dashes off.
findings.evidenceJa: 止める間もなく走り去っていく
findings.governingReading: she runs off before Shirou has time to stop her
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inability to intervene is changed into Illya declining to wait for a reply.

findings.highlight: I run after her, but I lose sight of her.
findings.evidenceJa: 追いつくどころかイリヤの背中さえ見失った
findings.governingReading: far from catching her, he loses sight even of her back
findings.explanation: The emphatic distance between catching Illya and merely keeping her in sight disappears.
